question: Due to a newly announced security advisory, a company has been informed that they must update the configuration of 500 network devices that are deployed in their network. The engineering team must assist the operations team to prepare for this update. The operations team does not have direct access to the network devices and must login via a Linux server. This is the first time that the team is making a network-wide configuration and must change all devices without first installing additional software on the network devices. The operations team is unfamiliar with automation and scripting technologies. Which automation tool must be used to accomplish this goal?
theory: Because Ansible needs no agent installed on the managed devices — it just needs SSH or NX-API reachability from the control host — the operations team can run it straight from the Linux jump server they already use, without pushing any new software to 500 devices first. Its YAML playbooks are also readable by a team new to automation, unlike Puppet/Chef/SaltStack, all of which require installing and maintaining agent software on every managed node before any change can be pushed. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 17 — Evaluate Automation and Orchestration Technologies)
